ITEM 1 | Bright yellow-orange grains, loose and separate, with slight sheen, fine grain texture, mounded in upper-left quadrant of a white square plate, covering roughly 20% of plate footprint, about 2 cm tall at mound | 150
ITEM 2 | Dark green wilted leafy greens with glossy moisture, thin stems visible, clumped and layered, covering roughly 25% of plate in upper-right, about 1.5 cm tall, sitting beside the yellow grains | 90
ITEM 3 | Golden-brown breaded fillet with a crumbly, toasted crust and a flaky white interior, cut into a piece about 7 cm by 5 cm, covering roughly 12% of plate in lower-right, about 2 cm thick | 130
ITEM 4 | Red-orange glossy sauce coating the breaded fillet and pooling beneath it, smooth and wet with a slight sheen, spread about 5 cm by 4 cm around the fillet | 35
ITEM 5 | Pale off-white flaky pieces with slightly translucent edges and a moist, tender look, scattered in lower-left with light brown bits, about 6 cm by 4 cm footprint, about 1 cm tall | 60
ITEM 6 | Small pieces of light brown cooked grain or onion-like bits, loose and crumbly, mixed with the pale flakes in lower-left, about 4 cm across, about 1 cm tall | 25
ITEM 7 | Scattered small dark green leaves, flat and glossy, a few lying on the plate edge near the fish and greens, each about 3 cm long | 10
